title: Nominal Cover to Meet Durability Requirements
notes: For main reinforcement up to 12 mm diameter bar for mild exposure the nominal cover may be reduced by 5 mm.
Unless specified otherwise, actual concrete cover should not deviate from the required nominal cover by +10 mm / 0 mm (printed as +10 over 0).
For exposure condition 'severe' and 'very severe', reduction of 5 mm may be made, where concrete grade is M35 and above.
